zh.problem: 有$$6$$名同学咨询成绩．老师说：甲不是$$6$$人中成绩最好的，乙不是$$6$$人中成绩最差的，而且$$6$$人的成绩各不相同．那么他们$$6$$人的成绩不同的可能排序共有 ．
zh.analysis: 解法一 以$$A$$记甲成绩排名第一的所有可能的排序之集， 以$$B$$记乙成绩排名为最后的所有可能的排序之集，则$$\left\textbar{} A \right\textbar=\left\textbar{} B \right\textbar=5!$$，$$\left\textbar{} A\cap B \right\textbar=4!$$． 甲排名第一或乙排名最后的所有可能的排序数为 $$\left\textbar{} A\cup B \right\textbar=\left\textbar{} A \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} B \right\textbar-\left\textbar{} A\cap B \right\textbar=216$$． 按照老师所述，这６位同学成绩可能的排序数为$$6!-216=504$$． 解法二 以乙的成绩不在最后为前提，考虑甲的成绩不在第一的所有可能排序． （$$1$$）甲的成绩排在最后的所有可能的排序数为$$A_{5}^{5}=120$$； （$$2$$）甲的成绩不在最后，又不在第一的所有可能排序数为$$C_{4}^{1}\cdot C_{4}^{1}\cdot A_{4}^{4}=384$$． 所以甲不在首，乙不在尾的所有可能排序数为$$120+384=504$$．

en.problem: There are $$6$$ students asking about their scores. The teacher said: Person A is not the one with the best grades among $$6$$, and Person B is not the one with the worst grades among $$6$$, and the grades of $$6$$ are different. Then there are a total of different possible rankings of their $$6$$ people’s scores.
en.analysis: Solution 1: Let $$A$$ record the set of all possible rankings where A's score ranks first, and use $$B$$ to record the set of all possible rankings where B's score ranks last, then $$\left\textbar{} A \right\textbar=\left\textbar{} B \right\textbar=5!$$, $$\left\textbar{} A\cap B \right\textbar=4!$$. All possible ranking numbers for A ranking first or B ranking last are $$\left\textbar{} A\cup B \right\textbar=\left\textbar{} A \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} B \right\textbar-\left\textbar{} A\cap B \right\textbar=216$$. According to the teacher, the possible rankings of these 6 students’ scores are $$6!-216=504$$. Solution 2: On the premise that B's score is not last, consider all possible rankings in which A's score is not first. ($$1$$) The number of possible rankings in which A’s grades are at the bottom is $$A_{5}^{5}=120$$; ($$2$$) The number of possible rankings in which A’s grades are neither at the bottom nor first is $$C_{4}^{1}\cdot C_{4}^{1}\cdot A_{4}^{4}=384$$. Therefore, the number of all possible sortings in which A is not at the beginning and B is not at the end is $$120+384=504$$.

zh.analysis: 一个数除以$$9$$的余数等于这个数各个数字之和除以$$9$$的余数，每次操作将数的和变为数字和，不改变除以$$9$$的余数，$$1+2+3+\cdots +2013=2014\times 2013\div 2=1007\times 2013$$，$$1007$$除以$$9$$的余数相同，余数为$$3$$，那么最后剩下的四个数字的和除以$$9$$也是余$$3$$的；将$$27$$拆分成四个数的乘积；$$27=3\times 3\times 3\times 1=3\times 9\times 1\times 1=27\times 1\times 1\times 1$$，和分别为$$10$$，$$14$$，$$30$$，只有$$30$$除以$$9$$余数为$$3$$，所以四个数的和为$$30$$．

en.problem: There are $$1\sim 2013$$ on the blackboard, a total of $$2013$$ numbers. You can erase two of the numbers each time and write the sum of the two numbers. It is known that there are four numbers left on the blackboard, and their product is $$27$$, then the sum of these four numbers is (~).
en.analysis: The remainder of dividing a number by $$9$$ is equal to the remainder of the sum of the digits of the number divided by $$9$$. Each operation changes the sum of the numbers into the sum of numbers and does not change the remainder of division by $$9$$. $$1+2+3+\cdots +2013=2014\times 2013\div 2=1007\times 2013$$, $$1007$$ divided by $$9$$ have the same remainder, the remainder is $$3$$, then the sum of the last remaining four numbers divided by $$9$$ also has a remainder of $$3$$; split $$27$$ into the product of four numbers; $$27=3\times 3\times 3\times 1=3\times 9\times 1\times 1=27\times 1\times 1\times 1$$, and the sums are $$10$$, $$14$$, and $$30$$ respectively. zh.problem: 已知\emph{x}，\emph{y}，\emph{z}是非负实数，且$x+y+z=2$，则$x^{2}y^{2}+y^{2}z^{2}+z^{2}x^{2}+xyz$的最大值为（~~~~~~~）
zh.analysis: \hfill\break 【分析】\\ 利用基本不等式可求最大值.\\ 【详解】\\ $2x^{2}y^{2}\leq xy\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)$，$2y^{2}z^{2}\leq yz\left(y^{2}+z^{2}\right)$，$2z^{2}x^{2}\leq zx\left(z^{2}+x^{2}\right)$，\\ 所以$2x^{2}y^{2}+2y^{2}z^{2}+2z^{2}x^{2}+2xyz\leq xy\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)+yz\left(y^{2}+z^{2}\right)+zx\left(z^{2}+x^{2}\right)+2xyz$，\\ $\leq xy\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)+yz\left(y^{2}+z^{2}\right)+zx\left(z^{2}+x^{2}\right)+\left(x+y+z\right)xyz$\\ $=\left(xy+yz+zx\right)\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)$\\ $=\frac{1}{2}\left(2xy+2yz+2zx\right)\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)$\\ $\leq \frac{1}{2}\frac{\left[\left(2xy+2yz+2zx\right)+\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)\right]^{2}}{2}=2$，\\ 因此所求代数式的最大值为1．\\ 故选：A.

en.problem: It is known that \emph{x}, \emph{y}, \emph{z} are non-negative real numbers, and $x+y+z=2$, then the maximum value of $x^{2}y^{2}+y^{2}z^{2}+z^{2}x^{2}+xyz$ is (~~~~~~~)
choices: None of the above answers are correct
en.analysis: \hfill\break [Analysis]\\ Use basic inequalities to find the maximum value.\\ [Detailed explanation]\\ $2x^{2}y^{2}\leq xy\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)$, $2y^{2}z^{2}\leq yz\left(y^{2}+z^{2}\right)$, $2z^{2}x^{2}\leq zx\left(z^{2}+x^{2}\right)$,\\ So $2x^{2}y^{2}+2y^{2}z^{2}+2z^{2}x^{2}+2xyz\leq xy\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)+yz\left(y^{2}+z^{2}\right)+zx\left(z^{2}+x^{2}\right)+2xyz$,\\ $\leq xy\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)+yz\left(y^{2}+z^{2}\right)+zx\left(z^{2}+x^{2}\right)+\left(x+y+z\right)xyz$\\ $=\left(xy+yz+zx\right)\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)$\\ $=\frac{1}{2}\left(2xy+2yz+2zx\right)\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)$\\ $\leq \frac{1}{2}\frac{\left[\left(2xy+2yz+2zx\right)+\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)\right]^{2}}{2}=2$,\\ Therefore, the maximum value of the algebraic formula is 1. \\ So choose: A.

zh.analysis: \hfill\break 【分析】\\ 观察$a={{\text{e}}^{0.2}}-1,b=\ln 1.2,c=\tan 0.2$，发现都含有$0.2$，把$0.2$换成$x$，自变量在$(0,1)$或其子集范围内构造函数，利用导数证明其单调性，比较$a,b,c$的大小.\\ 【详解】\\ 令$f(x)={{\text{e}}^{x}}-1-\tan x=\frac{\cos x{{\text{e}}^{x}}-\cos x-\sin x}{\cos x}$，$0\textless{} x\textless{} \frac{\pi }{4}$，\\ 令$g(x)=\cos x{{\text{e}}^{x}}-\cos x-\sin x$，${g}\textquotesingle(x)=(-\sin x+\cos x){{\text{e}}^{x}}+\sin x-\cos x=({{\text{e}}^{x}}-1)\cdot (\cos x-\sin x)$，\\ 当$0\textless{} x\textless{} \frac{\pi }{4}$时，${g}\textquotesingle(x)\textgreater0$，$g(x)$单调递增，\\ 又$g(0)=1-1=0$，所以$g(x)\textgreater0$，又$\cos x\textgreater0$，\\ 所以$f(x)\textgreater0$，在$(0,\frac{\pi }{4})$成立，所以$f(0.2)\textgreater0$即$a\textgreater c$，\\ 令$h(x)=\ln (x+1)-x$，${h}\textquotesingle(x)=\frac{1}{x+1}-1=\frac{-x}{x+1}$，$h(x)$在$x\in (0,\frac{\pi }{2})$为减函数，所以$h(x)\textless{} h(0)=0$，即$\ln (x+1)\textless{} x$，\\ 令$m(x)=x-\tan x$，${m}\textquotesingle(x)=1-\frac{1}{{{\cos }^{2}}x}$，$m(x)$在$x\in (0,\frac{\pi }{2})$为减函数，所以$m(x)\textless{} m(0)=0$，即$x\textless{} \tan x$，\\ 所以$\ln (x+1)\textless{} x\textless{} \tan x$，$x\in (0,\frac{\pi }{2})$成立，\\ 令$x=0.2$，则上式变为$\ln (0.2+1)\textless{} 0.2\textless{} \tan 0.2$，所以$b\textless{} 0.2\textless{} c$\\ 所以$b\textless{} c$，\\ 所以$b\textless{} c\textless{} a$.\\ 故答案为：B.\\ 【点睛】\\ 比较大小题目，是高考的热点，也是难点，通过观察和构造函数是基本的解题要求，难点在于构造后的证明，需要平时多积累常见的结论，达到深入理解，举一反三，融会贯通.

en.problem: It is known that $a={{\text{e}}^{0.2}}-1,b=\ln 1.2,c=\tan 0.2$, where $\text{e}=2.71828\cdots $ is the base of the natural logarithm, then (~~~~~~~)
en.analysis: \hfill\break [Analysis]\\ Observe $a={{\text{e}}^{0.2}}-1,b=\ln 1.2,c=\tan 0.2$, and find that they all contain $0.2$. Replace $0.2$ with $x$. Construct the function within the range of $(0,1)$ or its subset, use derivatives to prove its monotonicity, and compare the sizes of $a, b, c$.\\ [Detailed explanation] \\ Let $f(x)={{\text{e}}^{x}}-1-\tan x=\frac{\cos x{{\text{e}}^{x}}-\cos x-\sin x}{\cos x}$, $0\textless{} x\textless{} \frac{\pi }{4}$, \\ Let $g(x)=\cos x{{\text{e}}^{x}}-\cos x-\sin x$,${g}\textquotesingle(x)=(-\sin x+\cos x){{\text{e}}^{x}}+\sin x-\cos x=({{\text{e}}^{x}}-1)\cdot (\cos x-\sin x)$,\\ When $0\textless{} x\textless{} \frac{\pi }{4}$, ${g}\textquotesingle(x)\textgreater0$, $g(x)$ increases monotonically, \\ and $g(0)=1-1=0$, so $g(x)\textgreater0$, and $\cos x\textgreater0$,\\ So $f(x)\textgreater0$ is established at $(0,\frac{\pi }{4})$, so $f(0.2)\textgreater0$ is $a\textgreater c$,\\ Let $h(x)=\ln (x+1)-x$, ${h}\textquotesingle(x)=\frac{1}{x+1}-1=\frac{-x}{x+1}$, $h(x)$ is a decreasing function in $x\in (0,\frac{\pi }{2})$, so $h(x)\textless{} h(0)=0$, that is, $\ln (x+1)\textless{} x$,\\ Let $m(x)=x-\tan x$, ${m}\textquotesingle(x)=1-\frac{1}{{{\cos }^{2}}x}$, $m(x)$ is a decreasing function in $x\in (0,\frac{\pi }{2})$, so $m(x)\textless{} m(0)=0$, that is, $x\textless{} \tan x$,\\ So $\ln (x+1)\textless{} x\textless{} \tan x$, $x\in (0,\frac{\pi }{2})$ holds, \\ Let $x=0.2$, then the above formula becomes $\ln (0.2+1)\textless{} 0.2\textless{} \tan 0.2$, so $b\textless{} 0.2\textless{} c$\\ So $b\textless{} c$,\\ So $b\textless{} c\textless{} a$.\\ So the answer is: B.\\ [Key Point]\\ Comparing large and small questions is a hot topic and difficult point in the college entrance examination. Observation and constructing functions are the basic problem-solving requirements. The difficulty lies in the proof after construction. You need to accumulate more common conclusions in order to achieve in-depth understanding, draw inferences from one example, and integrate them all.

en.problem: Suppose $$p$$ and $$q$$ are both prime numbers greater than $$3$$, then the number of prime pairs $$(p,q)$$ such that $${{p}^{2}}+5pq+4{{q}^{2}}$$ is a perfect square number is (~).
en.analysis: Suppose $${{p}^{2}}+5pq+4{{q}^{2}}={{m}^{2}}$$ ($$m$$ is a natural number), then $${{(p+2q)}^{2}}+pq={{m}^{2}}$$, that is, $$(m-p-2q)(m+p+2q)=pq$$. Since $$pq$$ is a prime number, and $$m+p+2q\textgreater p$$, $$m+p+2q\textgreater q$$, so $$m-p-2q=1$$, $$m+p+2q=pq$$, so $$pq-2p-4q-1=0$$, that is, $$(p-4)(q-2)=9$$, Therefore, $$(p,q)=(5,11)$$ or $$(7,5)$$. Therefore, the number of prime pairs $$(p,q)$$ that satisfy the condition is $$2$$.

zh.problem: 对$n$个正整数用\emph{k}种颜色染色，使得无法从中选出三个不同色的正整数构成等差数列，设\emph{k}的最大值为$f(n)$，则（~~~~~~~）
zh.analysis: \hfill\break 【分析】\\ 利用特例可判断BCD的正误，利用整除性和数学归纳法可判断A的正误.\\ 【详解】\\ 取$n=4$，则$f(4)=3$，将1234染成$ABBC$即可．因此选项CD错误．\\ 下面证明$\log _{3}n\leq f(n)\leq \log _{2}n+1$．\\ 设$v(n,p)$为正整数\emph{n}中素数\emph{p}的幂次，即$p^{v(n,p)}\parallel n$．\\ 对于任意的正整数$m(1\leq m\leq n)$，将\emph{m}染成第$v(m,3)+1$种颜色，这样就用了$\left[\log _{3}n\right]+1$种颜色．\\ 此时对于任意不同色的正整数\emph{x}，\emph{y}，有$v(2x-y,3)=v(2y-x,3)=\min {v(x,3),v(y,3) }$，\\ 因此$2x-y$和$2y-x$均与\emph{x}，\emph{y}之一同色，符合题意．这样就证明了$f(n)\geq \left[\log _{3}n\right]+1\textgreater{} \log _{3}n$．\\ 接下来设$2^{k}\leq n\textless{} 2^{k+1}\left(k\in \mathbf{N}^{\ast }\right)$，则右侧不等式即$f(n)\leq k+1$．\\ 对\emph{k}进行归纳，应用数学归纳法证明．\\ 当$k=1$时，$n=2,3$，此时$f(n)=2$，命题成立．\\ 假设命题对$k-1$成立，对已有$1,2,\cdots ,2^{k}-1$的染色，考虑1，2，\ldots，\emph{n}的染色，若其中有两种或两种以上新增的颜色，不妨设为红色和蓝色，且最小的红色数为\emph{x}，最小的蓝色数为\emph{y}，且$x\textless{} y$，则$2^{k}\leq x\textless{} y\leq n\textless{} 2^{k+1}\Rightarrow 2x-y\textgreater{} 0$，\\ 考虑正整数$2x-y$，它与异色数对$(x,y)$成等差数列，于是必然与\emph{x}，\emph{y}之一同色，但$2x-y\textless{} x\textless{} y$，这与之前假设的\emph{x}，\emph{y}的最小性矛盾．\\ 因此1，2，\ldots，\emph{n}的染色至多在之前的基础上增加1种，从而命题得证．\\ 综上所述，有$\log _{3}n\leq f(n)\leq \log _{2}n+1$．\\ 接下来考虑$n=9$的情形，此时$f(n)=3$，排除选项B．\\ 故选：A.

en.problem: Color $n$ positive integers with \emph{k} colors, so that three positive integers of different colors cannot be selected to form an arithmetic sequence. Suppose the maximum value of \emph{k} is $f(n)$, then (~~~~~~~)
en.analysis: \hfill\break [Analysis]\\ Use special cases to determine whether BCD is correct, and use divisibility and mathematical induction to determine whether A is correct.\\ [Detailed Explanation] \\ Take $n=4$, then $f(4)=3$, and dye 1234 into $ABBC$. Therefore option CD is wrong. \\ The following proves that $\log _{3}n\leq f(n)\leq \log _{2}n+1$. \\ Let $v(n,p)$ be the power of the prime number \emph{p} in the positive integer \emph{n}, that is, $p^{v(n,p)}\parallel n$. \\ For any positive integer $m(1\leq m\leq n)$, dye \emph{m} into the $v(m,3)+1$th color, thus using the $\left[\log _{3}n\right]+1$ color. \\ At this time, for any positive integers \emph{x} and \emph{y} of different colors, $v(2x-y,3)=v(2y-x,3)=\min {v(x,3),v(y,3) }$,\\ Therefore $2x-y$ and $2y-x$ both have the same color as one of \emph{x} and \emph{y}, which is consistent with the meaning of the question. This proves that $f(n)\geq \left[\log _{3}n\right]+1\textgreater{} \log _{3}n$. \\ Next, let $2^{k}\leq n\textless{} 2^{k+1}\left(k\in \mathbf{N}^{\ast }\right)$, then the inequality on the right side is $f(n)\leq k+1$. \\ Make an induction on \emph{k} and prove it by mathematical induction. \\ When $k=1$, $n=2,3$, at this time $f(n)=2$, the proposition is established. \\ Assume that the proposition is true for $k-1$. For the coloring of $1, 2, \cdots, 2^{k}-1$, consider the coloring of 1, 2, \ldots, \emph{n}. If there are two or more new colors, it may be set as red and blue, and the minimum number of red is \emph{x}, the minimum number of blue is \emph{y}, and $x\textless{} y$, then $2^{k}\leq x\textless{} y\leq n\textless{} 2^{k+1}\Rightarrow 2x-y\textgreater{} 0$,\\ Consider the positive integer $2x-y$, which forms an arithmetic sequence with the heterochromatic number pair $(x,y)$, so it must be of the same color as one of \emph{x}, \emph{y}, but $2x-y\textless{} x\textless{} y$, which is inconsistent with the minimum of the previously assumed \emph{x}, \emph{y}. \\ Therefore, the coloring of 1, 2, \ldots, \emph{n} can be increased by at most one color on the basis of the previous ones, and the proposition is proved. \\ In summary, there are $\log _{3}n\leq f(n)\leq \log _{2}n+1$. \\ Next, consider the case of $n=9$. At this time, $f(n)=3$, excluding option B. \\ So choose: A.

en.analysis: Suppose the distance between the two docks is $$s$$, the speed of the ship in still water is $$a$$, and the water speed is $${{v}_{0}}$$, then the time for a round trip is $${{t}_{0}}=\frac{s}{a+{{v}_{0}}}+\frac{s}{a-{{v}_{0}}}$$, Assume that the river water speed increases to $$v(v\textgreater{{v}_{0}})$$, then the time taken for a round trip is $$t=\frac{s}{a+v}+\frac{s}{a-v}$$. Calculation: $${{t}_{0}}-t=\frac{s}{a+{{v}_{0}}}+\frac{s}{a-{{v}_{0}}}-\frac{s}{a+v}-\frac{s}{a-v}$$ $$=s[(\frac{1}{a+{{v}_{0}}}-\frac{1}{a+v})+(\frac{1}{a-{{v}_{0}}}-\frac{1}{a-v})]$$ $$=s[\frac{v-{{v}_{0}}}{(a+{{v}_{0}})(a+v)}+\frac{{{v}_{0}}-v}{(a-{{v}_{0}})(a-v)}]$$ $$=s(v-{{v}_{0}})[\frac{1}{(a+{{v}_{0}})(a+v)}-\frac{1}{(a-{{v}_{0}})(a-v)}]$$. Since $$v-{{v}_{0}}\textgreater0$$, $$a+{{v}_{0}}\textgreater a-{{v}_{0}}$$, $$a+v\textgreater a-v$$ so $$(a+{{v}_{0}})(a+v)\textgreater(a-{{v}_{0}})(a-v)$$, Therefore $$\frac{1}{(a+{{v}_{0}})(a+v)}\textless\frac{1}{(a-{{v}_{0}})(a-v)}$$, That is $$\frac{1}{(a+{{v}_{0}})(a+v)}-\frac{1}{(a-{{v}_{0}})(a-v)}\textless0$$. ∴$${{t}_{0}}-t\textless0$$, that is, $${{t}_{0}}\textless t$$. Therefore, the time it takes for the river water speed to increase will increase, so choose $$\text{A}$$.

zh.analysis: $$M$$与$$W$$都是五位数，都有千位和十位与其它数位的大小关系，所以两类数有一定的对应关系．比如有一个符合要求的五位数$$M=\overline{ABCDE}$$($$A$$不为$$0)$$，那么就有一个与之相反并对应的五位数$$\overline{(9-A)(9-B)(9-C)(9-D)(9-E)}$$必属于$$4$$类，比如$$13254$$为$$M$$类，则与之对应的$$86754$$为$$W$$类． 所以对于$$M$$类的每一个数，$$n-1$$类都有一个数与之对应．但是两类数的个数不是一样多，因为$$M$$类中$$0$$不能做首位，而$$W$$类中$$9$$可以做首位．所以$$W$$类的数比$$M$$类的数要多，多的就是就是首位为$$\underbrace{{{a}_{n-1}}+{{a}_{n}}=3\times 3\times \ldots \times3}_{(n-1)3}={{3}^{n-1}}$$的符合要求的数． 计算首位为$${{a}_{1}}=0$$的$$W$$类的数的个数，首先要确定另外四个数，因为要求各不相同，从除$$9$$外的其它$$9$$个数字中选出$$4$$个，有$$C_{9}^{4}=126$$种选法． 对于每一种选法选出来的$$4$$个数，假设其大小关系为$$5$$，由于其中最小的数只能在千位和十位上，最大的数只能在百位和个位上，所以符合要求的数有$$60$$类：①千位、十位排$${{A}_{1}}$$、$${{A}_{2}}$$，有两种方法，百位、十位排$${{A}_{3}}$$、$${{A}_{4}}$$，也有两种方法，故此时共有$$3$$种；②千位、十位排$$0$$、$${{A}_{3}}$$，只能是千位$${{A}_{3}}$$，百位$${{A}_{4}}$$，十位$$3$$，个位$$6$$，只有$$3$$种方法． 根据乘法原理，首位为$$9$$的$$W$$类的数有$$126\times \left( 4+1 \right)=630$$个．

en.problem: There is a type of five-digit number $$M$$ with different digits. Its thousands digit is larger than the two digits on the left and right, and its tens digit is also larger than the two digits on the left and right. There is another type of five-digit number $$W$$ with different digits. Its thousands digit is smaller than the two digits on the left and right, and its tens digit is also smaller than the two digits on the left and right. Please tell me which category has more numbers $$M$$ and $$W$$ that meet the requirements:~\uline{~~~~~~~~~~}~, more~\uline{~~~~~~~~~~}~
en.analysis: $$M$$ and $$W$$ are both five-digit numbers, and both have a relationship between the thousands and tens digits and other digits, so the two types of numbers have a certain corresponding relationship. For example, if there is a five-digit $$M=\overline{ABCDE}$$($$A$$ is not $$0)$$ that meets the requirements, then there is an opposite and corresponding five-digit $$\overline{ (9-A)(9-B)(9-C)(9-D)(9-E)}$$ must belong to class $$4$$. zh.analysis: 六个足球队进行单循环比赛，总共有$$5+4+3+2+1=15$$（场）比赛． 平局的两队总分为$$1+1=2$$（分），非平局总分为$$0+3=3$$（分），因此，如果全是非平局总分有$$15\times 3=45$$（分），否则多一场平局总分减少$$1$$分． 由于第$$3$$名得了$$8$$分，最后一名至少$$0$$分，所以各队得分的构成的等差数列的公差不超过$$8\div 3=2\frac{2}{3}$$（分），只可能为$$1$$分或$$2$$分． 如果各队得分的构成的等差数列公差为$$1$$，则这六个队的总分为$$（8+7）\times 3=45$$（分），则有$$0$$场平局，每场比赛每队都得$$0$$分或$$3$$分，则每支队的得分都应是$$3$$的倍数，与第$$3$$名得$$8$$分不符． 如果各队得分的构成的等差数列公差为$$2$$，则这六个队的总分为$$（8+6）\times 3=42$$（分），有$$45-42=3$$（场）平局，符合题意．所以这次比赛中共有$$3$$场平局．

en.problem: Six football teams $$A$$, $$B$$, $$C$$, $$D$$, $$E$$, and $$F$$ compete in a single round-robin competition. Each two teams must play one game and only one game. The winner gets $$3$$ points, the loser gets $$0$$ points, and each team in a tie gets $$1$$ points. As a result of the game, the scores of each team from high to low are exactly an arithmetic sequence. The team that won $$3$$ got $$8$$ points, so there were ~\uline{~~~~~~~~~~}~ draws in this game.
en.analysis: Six football teams compete in a single round robin, with a total of $$5+4+3+2+1=15$$ (games). The total score of the two teams in a tie is $$1+1=2$$ (points), and the total score of the non-tie is $$0+3=3$$ (points). Therefore, if it is all non-tie, the total score is $$15\times 3=45$$ (points). Otherwise, the total score of one more tie will be reduced by $$1$$ points. Since the $$3$$ place got $$8$$ points and the last place got at least $$0$$ points, the tolerance of the arithmetic sequence composed of the scores of each team does not exceed $$8\div 3=2\frac{2}{3}$$ (points), and it can only be $$1$$ points or $$2$$ points. If the tolerance of the arithmetic sequence of the scores of each team is $$1$$, then the total score of the six teams is $$(8+7)\times 3=45$$ (points), then there are $$0$$ draws, and each team gets $$0$$ points or $$3$$ points in each game. Then the score of each team should be a multiple of $$3$$, which is inconsistent with the $$8$$ points awarded by the $$3$$ place. If the tolerance of the arithmetic sequence of the scores of each team is $$2$$, then the total score of these six teams is $$(8+6)\times 3=42$$ (points), and there are $$45-42=3$$ (games) draws, which is in line with the meaning of the question. So there were a total of $$3$$ draws in this game.

There are three situations: adding $$3$$ and subtracting $$3$$. (For example, the number of $$1$$ and $$2$$ will either be reduced by one at the same time; or the number of $$1$$ will be increased by $$2$$, and the number of $$2$$ will be reduced by one; or the number of $$1$$ will be reduced by $$1$$, and the number of $$2$$ will be increased by $$2$$, corresponding to: the number difference remains unchanged, plus $$3$$, or minus $$3$$) In fact, to further characterize this feature: the numerical difference between any two numbers is congruent to $$3$$ (that is, the remainder after dividing by $$3$$ remains unchanged) Then continue, look at the number of $$1$$ and the number of $$2$$, subtract the number of $$1$$ from the number of $$2$$, their difference is $$22-11=11$$, the remainder of $$11$$ divided by $$3$$ is $$2$$, that is to say, when the number of numbers $$2$$ is greater than $$1$$ When there are many numbers, their difference must be divided by $$3$$ with a remainder of $$2$$; but if the number of numbers $$1$$ is more than $$2$$, then the remainder of the difference divided by $$3$$ must be $$1$$, (you can try the operation several times to make the number of $$1$$ more than the number of $$2$$). It is troublesome to calculate this. If you look at some special cases that do not need to be classified and discussed, you can find that the difference between the number of $$1$$ and the number of $$4$$ is $$33$$, which is exactly a multiple of $$3$$. That is to say, at the end of the operation, the number of remaining $$1$$ and the number of $$4$$ will either be the same, or the number will differ by $$3$$. According to the meaning of the question, there are only $$3$$ left in the end. If the number of $$1$$ is $$3$$, then the number of $$2$$ must be $$2$$, which is not in line with the meaning of the question. If the number of $$3$$ is $$3$$, and $$1$$ and $$2$$ cannot both be $$0$$, so at the end of the operation, the number of $$1$$ and the number of $$4$$ can only be $$0$$, and $ The number of $2$$ must be $$2$$, then the number of $$3$$ is $$1$$, so the remaining three numbers are $$2$$$$2$$ and $$1$$$$3$$, and their product is $$12$$.

zh.problem: $$a$$，$$b$$，$$c$$都是质数，且$$a+b+c+abc=99$$，则$$\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b} \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{b}-\frac{1}{c} \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{c}-\frac{1}{a} \right\textbar=$$ ．
zh.analysis: 若$$a$$，$$b$$，$$c$$都是奇数，那么$$abc$$也为奇数，则$$a+b+c+abc$$为偶数，与$$a+b+c+abc=99$$矛盾． ∴$$a$$，$$b$$，$$c$$中必有一个偶数， 又∵$$a$$，$$b$$，$$c$$都是质数， ∴$$a$$，$$b$$，$$c$$中必有一个偶数是$$2$$， 令$$a=2$$，则$$b+c+2bc=97$$， 同理，若$$b$$，$$c$$都是奇数，则$$bc$$为奇数，则$$b+c+2bc$$为偶数，与$$b+c+2bc=97$$矛盾， ∴$$b$$，$$c$$中也必有一个偶数，则偶数必是$$2$$， 令$$b=2$$，可得$$c=19$$， ∴$$\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b} \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{b}-\frac{1}{c} \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{c}-\frac{1}{a} \right\textbar=\frac{17}{19}$$． 故答案为：$$\frac{17}{19}$$．

en.problem: $$a$$, $$b$$, $$c$$ are all prime numbers, and $$a+b+c+abc=99$$, then $$\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b} \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{b}-\frac{1}{c} \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{c}-\frac{1}{a} \right\textbar=$$ ．
en.analysis: If $$a$$, $$b$$, $$c$$ are all odd numbers, then $$abc$$ is also an odd number, then $$a+b+c+abc$$ is an even number, which is inconsistent with $$a+b+c+abc=99$$. ∴$$a$$, $$b$$, $$c$$ must have an even number, and ∵$$a$$, $$b$$, $$c$$ are all prime numbers, ∴$$a$$, $$b$$, $$c$$ must have an even number which is $$2$$, let $$a=2$$, then $$b+c+2bc=97$$, In the same way, if $$b$$ and $$c$$ are both odd numbers, then $$bc$$ is an odd number, then $$b+c+2bc$$ is an even number, which is inconsistent with $$b+c+2bc=97$$. ∴$$b$$, $$c$$ must also have an even number, then the even number must be $$2$$, Let $$b=2$$, we can get $$c=19$$, ∴$$\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b} \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{b}-\frac{1}{c} \right\textbar+\left\textbar{} \frac{1}{c}-\frac{1}{a} \right\textbar=\frac{17}{19}$$． So the answer is: $$\frac{17}{19}$$.
